newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel protests to ceasefire group on attack.
newsitem.headline: Israel protests to ceasefire group on attack.

text.p: Israel on Saturday complained to a five-nation Lebanon monitoring group that a Katyusha rocket attack on northern Israel violated a ceasefire in south Lebanon, the Israeli army said.
"Israel views with great severity the Katyusha fire as a violation of ceasefire understandings," an army spokesman said in a statement.

The Israeli army had said Katyusha rockets slammed into Israel's Western Galilee region Friday night -- the first such assault against northern Israel since a U.S.-brokered understanding ended a 17-day Israeli blitz against Hizbollah guerrillas in April.

The pro-Iranian Hizbollah (Party of God), which is fighting to oust Israel from a south Lebanon occupation zone, denied firing the Katyushas. Three radical Palestinian guerrilla groups contacted by Reuters also denied involvement.
Israel said it would discuss the attack at a meeting of a ceasefire monitoring committee comprised of the United States, France, Syria, Lebanon and Israel on Monday.
The army said it located Katyusha debris on Saturday in the Galilee region. The attack caused no casualties or damage.

Hizbollah -- which followed a policy of firing Katyushas into Israel whenever Israeli shelling caused Lebanese civilian casualties -- has refrained from such attacks under the accord that bars the targetting of civilians areas by both sides.
Some 200 people, mainly civilians, were killed in the relentless Israeli air, land and sea bombardment in April aimed at crushing Hizbollah.
The ceasefire agreement does not bar guerrilla raids on Israeli forces occupying a border zone in south Lebanon, and gives both sides the right to self-defence.
Israel set up the 15-km (nine-miles)-deep south zone when it withdrew the bulk of its 1982 invasion force in 1985 to protect its northern settlements from guerrilla attacks.
Israeli troops killed two Hizbollah guerrillas on Saturday near the village of Rihan in the security zone after being ambushed by a Hizbollah unit, the Israeli army said.
There were no casualties to the Israeli force.
